title: SegGPT: Towards Segmenting Everything In Context
mechanism: ViT-L trained as in-context colouring: given (image, mask) prompts with random colour maps it paints the query mask; multiple prompts ensembled by feature averaging.
evidence: R: strong in-domain and out-of-domain results on few-shot semantic, VOS, semantic and panoptic segmentation; no thin-structure evidence.
adaptation: Gray to 3 channels; 448 px canvas halves each cell so 1-2 px cracks vanish: use for inactive and structural classes; fixed colour per class in prompt masks; supports retrieved by source; the standard in-context row in the benchmark K-shot track.
min_experiment: In G0 and the K-shot track: SegGPT K=1/4/16 vs house PF fine-tuned on the same K cells; metrics inactive IoU, mIoU_rob classes; kill as labeller if below house PF on all classes.
